name: com.nashouse/mcp
title: Nas House
description: Search and read Nas House articles: villa stays, coworking, events and retreats in Dubai.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Find Nas House articles by keywords (for example "day pass price", "garden event capacity", "check-in time"). Returns up to `limit` matching articles with slug, summary, topic, tags, dates and URLs, best match first. Start here; then call get_article with a slug to read one in full.

query.description: Keywords or a short question, for example "how many guests can stay overnight".

topic.description: Optional topic slug to restrict results, as returned by list_topics.

tag.description: Optional tag slug to restrict results, as returned by list_tags (for example "events").

limit.description: Maximum results to return, 1 to 20. Default 5.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Return the full Markdown of one article, chosen by slug from search_articles, list_topics or list_tags. Also reads the site pages "pricing" (published prices in AED), "contact", "about" and "privacy". Use this after you know which document you need; use search_articles when you only have keywords.

slug.description: Article or page slug, for example "day-pass-or-monthly-membership" or "pricing".

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List every topic (Stay, Membership and coworking, Events, Retreats, Health, Dubai guides) with its description, article count and the slugs and titles of its articles. Use it to browse when you have no keywords, or to pick a topic filter for search_articles.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List every tag used by published articles (for example "Events", "Al Barsha", "first visit"), most used first, with its slug, article count, page URL and the slugs and titles of its articles. Use it to browse when you have no keywords, or to pick a tag filter for search_articles.
